scope: offline research binding only; no live, admission, portfolio, or automatic promotion authority
supersession_scope: The parent54 ElasticNet remains historic evidence. New Meta HPO and Meta feature-contract screening must use the allcontracts81 P3 GateProxy binding.

selection.proposal: Top 3 expected gate-improving trials, plus one high-disagreement exploration and one descriptor-diverse control if the MC1 label budget permits
selection.hard_checks: retain predeclared strict-OOF residual-IC and weekly-Q10 safety checks as non-ranking exclusions only
selection.confirmation: every candidate needs a fresh matched six-month MC1 replay; only its actual dual-admission and constrained-portfolio result can advance it

feature_selection.required_confirmation: fresh MC1 for every top feature contract; never select solely on proxy prediction
feature_selection.f128: exploratory only until the feature contract has at least six independently MC1-labelled trials

forbidden: Use of proxy outputs in live trading or model inference
Automatic promotion from a proxy shortlist
